login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your big day.

twoFactor.label: 2FA code
twoFactor.help: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app (or a backup code).

errors.generic: Something went wrong while signing in.
errors.twoFactorSetupRequired: Your role requires 2FA. Ask an admin to reset your password and configure 2FA on first login — or to relax the policy.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a reset link by email and WhatsApp (if registered).
forgot.sent: If the email exists in our records, we'll send a reset link. Check your inbox and the registered WhatsApp number. The link expires in 60 minutes.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Pick a new password for your account.
reset.success: Password reset successfully. Use the new password to sign in.
reset.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

passwordPolicy.minLength: Password must be at least {min} characters long.
passwordPolicy.tooLong: Password must be at most 128 characters.
